description: A temporary URL to upload one file straight to the bucket, for clients that can run code: send the bytes with an HTTP PUT (with the same Content-Type when one is given), then call complete_upload. The content never passes through Nubbo.

conflict.description: When the path exists: fail (default), rename the new file, or replace the old one

path.description: Path of the new file, such as "reports/q3.pdf"

name: create_upload_link
title: Create an upload link
